name: @happyvertical/smrt-capacitor-session
reason: Capacitor WebView shells (Hearth) keep a cookie session, not a native bearer session. smrt-mobile and smrt-android are private Kotlin/Compose packages with no WebView and no npm distribution, so they cannot supply a Capacitor plugin; this publishes the one plugin that flushes the WebView CookieManager.

name: @happyvertical/smrt-app-shell#./shutdown
reason: The ordered SIGTERM/SIGINT shutdown (end streams, stop imports, drain open apps, exit) that the published server's ./start installs and a host embedding the build can install itself. The root entry is the shell's browser-safe surface and ./engine is the engine that must not import the shell, so neither can hold server process lifecycle.

name: @happyvertical/smrt-app-shell#./start
reason: Starts the published SvelteKit server build (the packaged build/ directory and the bin) with the graceful shutdown installed. The root entry exports no runnable server and ./engine must not import SvelteKit or the shell, so a package consumer had no way to run the shipped build.

name: _smrt_ai_run_ids
reason: Run ids must stay reserved after retention deletes the run row, so the registry cannot live in _smrt_ai_runs (stub rows would make every reader filter them) and has no tenant column; _smrt_run_once_claims keys by actor and tenant scope, not a global digest.

name: @happyvertical/smrt-app-shell:AppImport
reason: The shell's record of one workbook import: stored file, owner-facing state, findings, retained plan and the draft it created. The run itself stays in the workflow and job tables; AppDraft holds draft data, not import status, and CourseBundleImport is education-specific.

name: @happyvertical/smrt-app-shell:ChangeBatch
reason: The owner's changes waiting (#5178): the ordered structural changes not yet applied to the live app, with the digest, check state, generation counter and the live versions Apply made (what Undo takes back). AppDraft is only the private working copy rebuilt from these cards, and has no owner-facing state, digest or applied-undo record.

name: @happyvertical/smrt-app-shell:ChangeCard
reason: One owner-meaningful change in a ChangeBatch: its engine commands, order, source, revision, checks and review questions, soft-removable so it can be put back. AppDraftVersion stores resulting definitions without the commands, so a card cannot be removed from the middle of a chain from it.

name: @happyvertical/smrt-commerce:AccountingConnection
reason: A tenant-level (not user-owned) connection to an accounting provider: realm, environment, status, last error and the refresh lease that serializes Intuit's rotating refresh token. TenantPaymentAccount is a Stripe Connect payments account with its own capability and fee model, and SocialAccount is user-bound publishing state; neither can hold the accounting lease or the needs_reconnect/disconnected lifecycle, and the token itself stays in smrt-secrets.

name: @happyvertical/smrt-commerce:AccountingInvoiceReadback
reason: The stored provider readback of one synced invoice (projection, in_step/drift/needs_reconciliation, provider-only payments, observation time), re-written on every read. Invoice is a frozen money document whose sync identity must not change on a read, and TaxSummaryReport is a local tax projection; this is a provider-observed cache keyed per invoice.

name: @happyvertical/smrt-commerce:AccountingMapping
reason: A reference from a commerce record to the provider's record, keyed by tenant, provider, realm and environment so a different company never reuses it. Customer and TaxCode hold local facts only (Invoice.customerExternalId was a flat, unscoped string), and adding provider ids to them would tie every local row to one realm; the mapping set is also what builds the frozen tax mapping the sync requires.

name: @happyvertical/smrt-commerce:AccountingPaymentSync
reason: The exactly-once push record for one payment per company and environment: persisted request id, attempt owner, unknown/rejected/synced state. Invoice keeps this in its command-owned accountingSyncStateJson, but a payment can be pushed to several companies over time and Payment's settlement fields are frozen once completed, so the push state needs its own unique-keyed row rather than extra columns on Payment.

name: @happyvertical/smrt-messages:Correspondent
reason: One person's private, mail-derived address book entry (counts, last contact, readable-account lineage) with an optional link to a Profile. Profile is a tenant-visible identity record and cannot carry per-owner derived counts or per-owner privacy; UserNotification is the per-user row pattern (owner-filtered service, generated surfaces off) this follows.

name: @happyvertical/smrt-messages#./connect
reason: Server-only mailbox OAuth connect (start and complete) built on the shared smrt-secrets connect kernel. smrt-social/connect is X-specific and would pull social's content and video packages into mail; the root entry stays free of the OAuth flow so browser bundles do not load it.

name: @happyvertical/smrt-secrets#./connect
reason: The provider-neutral credential connect kernel (single-use state, PKCE, safe return path, generic OAuth 2.0 and OIDC mechanics) that smrt-social and smrt-messages both consume. ./service is the secret store and smrt-social/connect holds the platform-specific flow, so neither could host a shared kernel without a social or messaging dependency.

name: @happyvertical/smrt-secrets:ConnectState
reason: One in-flight credential connect (state, PKCE verifier, redirect, initiating user) for flows that are not social platforms. OAuthState is typed to social platforms and lives in smrt-social, which smrt-messages must not depend on; smrt-social keeps OAuthState behind the same store contract, so no table moves.
